newsitem.title: PERU: Lima share prices end mixed, miners see best gains.
newsitem.headline: Lima share prices end mixed, miners see best gains.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed mixed Friday, as interest in mining shares sucked funds from other sectors in a trend that was expected to continue Monday, brokers said.

Friday, the General Index edged down 0.02 percent to 2,126.7 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index rose 0.73 percent to 3,074.0 points, according to preliminary figures given at the market's close.
In a total of 2,685 trades, volume was a healthy 50.2 million soles ($18.9 million), brokers said.

"The international prices for zinc have returned to higher levels and this has made some investors get out of stocks with good medium-term prospects to buy the polymetallic miners," said Manuel Torres of local brokerage Finvest.

Atacocha, which announced Friday it had concluded a program to reduce almost a third of its workforce, dominated the market. The polymetallic miner saw 2.0 million shares change hands as it rose 3.0 percent to close at 2.40 soles.
Another polymetallic miner, Morococha, climbed 4.4 percent to close at 6.42 soles on 321,000 shares.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru fell 0.15 percent to 6.83 soles on volume of 1.7 million shares.
